request: Hey Claude, I just added the "referral-program" skill. Design a referral or affiliate program for us from our own data. Sign-ups are what we'd pay on. A customer brings in about $1,000 in the first year and our gross margin is about 80%.

accounts.google_ads: connected, but it belongs to a different business (a client), so it is left out

date_ranges.search_console: 2026-07-06 to 2026-08-19 and 2026-08-20 to 2026-10-03 (two 45-day halves ending 3 days ago)

data_pulled: GA4 get_report: sessions, new users, engaged sessions, key events by sessionDefaultChannelGroup
GA4 get_report: same metrics by sessionSource and sessionMedium
GA4 get_report: users, sessions, engaged sessions, key events by firstUserDefaultChannelGroup
GA4 get_report: landingPagePlusQueryString filtered to referral parameters
GA4 get_report: eventName counts; list_key_events; list_custom_dimensions
GA4 get_report: orderCoupon transactions and revenue
Search Console search_analytics by query for each 45-day half, row_limit 25000
Klaviyo get_flows, get_flow_report (last_90_days), get_lists, get_segments, get_coupons
note: Real run on our own accounts, anonymised: brand, domain, pages, queries, competitors and ids replaced; numbers rounded to 2 significant figures, so totals may not add up exactly. Third-party referring sites other than youtube.com are described by type. First-year revenue and margin are the example request's input, not account data.
